DiagramSheet.title: DiagramSheet
DiagramSheet.description: Represents a shared single-line diagram sheet containing transformers, switches, feeder lines, and annotations.

feederCode.description: Feeder code identifier such as FAA-06

transformers.description: List of transformer objects on this diagram sheet

switches.description: List of switch and cutout objects on this diagram sheet

feederPaths.description: List of feeder line path objects on this diagram sheet

annotations.description: List of text annotation labels on this diagram sheet

workspaceId.description: Shared workspace identifier (pea-fang-shared) so all team members access the same diagrams without login

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the sheet was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the sheet was last updated

/sheets/{sheetId}.description: Stores shared diagram sheets for all users under workspaceId pea-fang-shared.
